name: io.github.cyanheads/uniprot-mcp-server
description: Protein research over UniProtKB: search by function, fetch curated records, map IDs, proteomes.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: UNIPROT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: UniProt REST base URL. Override for a private mirror or testing.

environmentVariables.name: UNIPROT_ID_MAPPING_BUDGET_MS
environmentVariables.description: Milliseconds uniprot_map_ids polls a mapping job — a fresh submission and a ticket call alike — before returning a resumable ticket. Keep it below UNIPROT_TIMEOUT_MS. The whole call, results read included, ends within 50 seconds.

environmentVariables.name: UNIPROT_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Page size (1–500) for search and proteome protein listing when the caller leaves size unset.

environmentVariables.name: UNIPROT_CLAMP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Serve an over-the-cap size (search, proteome, ID mapping) at 500 with a notice, accept any section_limit, and accept up to 500 accessions on uniprot_get_entry (the first 20 distinct fetched, the rest deferred). Set false to reject them instead (size and section_limit above 500, more than 20 accessions).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
